title: Canonical Capability Catalogue (ADR-SHARED-017)
description: The explicit index of every canonical Baobab capability. It answers only: which canonical capabilities exist, who stewards their meaning, and which Shared definition document holds each definition. It never answers which providers implement a capability, which are certified or active, where they run, or who is entitled or bound: those belong to provider declarations, EA-09 and the Control Plane. A capability is canonical if and only if it is listed here; no consumer discovers capabilities by scanning files or guessing names (ADR-SHARED-017 SS19, SS30, SS54). The root validates a whole catalogue.yaml.

capabilities.description: Every canonical capability, once, sorted by capability_key so that the catalogue and every projection of it are deterministic.

owner.description: Repository stewarding the capability's semantics; must equal the definition's own owner. Not a provider monopoly (ADR-SHARED-017 SS15).

source.description: Path of the CapabilityDefinitionDocument (capability.schema.json#/$defs/CapabilityDefinitionDocument) holding the definition, relative to this catalogue, e.g. ../../payments/v1/capabilities.yaml. YAML or JSON: serialization is not membership.
